terms.gloss: prevail upon by asking; get by asking
evidence: Plaut. Asin. 707b: Numquam hercle hodiē exōrābis.
Cic. Rosc. Com. 46: ut pējeret, exōrāre facile poterō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: To go on asking until one gets one’s way: exōrāre aliquem ut …. One who can be talked round is exōrābilis.

phrases.latin: Amābō, Libane, jam sat est. — Numquam hercle hodiē exōrābis.
phrases.english: Please, Libanus, that’s enough now. — You’ll never talk me round today, by Hercules.

sources: Lewis & Short: exoro
